title: fix: clarify canonical model identity policy
author: ElliotEtag
pr_body_excerpt:
- Defines canonical public IDs as lowercase `<publisher-slug>/<official-model-slug>` while keeping provider deployment IDs internal.
- Adds aliases only for an existing compatibility contract or explicit approval.
- Keeps brand-new models out of `MODEL_SLUGS.md`; that file is only for historical public-ID renames.

gist.headline: Names in the seed ledger
gist.blurb: The model garden got a clearer labeling rule: public names stay canonical, while provider deployment plumbing remains underground.
gist.summary: Updated the model-management skill to define public model IDs as lowercase `<publisher-slug>/<official-model-slug>`, reserve aliases for approved compatibility contracts, and limit `MODEL_SLUGS.md` to historical public-ID renames.
gist.impact: Future model additions get consistent canonical API identities while provider-specific deployment IDs remain internal and compatibility aliases stay deliberate.
gist.visual_concept: Polli acts as a careful garden librarian, attaching neat canonical name tags to model-seed packets while tangled provider deployment labels are stored in a small back-room drawer. A tiny code-plant garden and a glowing retro terminal make the policy feel organized rather than bureaucratic.
